Welcome to Random Realizations!
This blog is a celebration of the fascinating world of data science.
I hope you find the content useful, and I hope you enjoy reading along and learning with me!

And me? Well, I'm Matt Bowers; I'm a data scientist.
Most recently I was a staff DS at AG1 where I use causal modeling to lead the science behind marketing measurement and growth.
Before that I worked at Uber where I solved a variety of problems using statistical modeling and machine learning. 
And before Uber I earned an MS in Applied Statistics and a PhD in Atmospheric Sciences at Purdue University where I studied the spatial-temporal correlation structure of tropical convection systems and developed statistical methods for climate research.

Posts are published here and on [Python-Bloggers](https://python-bloggers.com/).
If you want to get notified when I post something, go ahead and [subscribe]().
